title: Osaka event staff onboarding and reimbursements notes
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal/runbook notes for the Osaka user meetup (Nov 10–12, 2025). Mostly for staff onboarding, reimbursements process reminders, and vendor handoffs. This is a working list — send corrections to #events-japan on Slack or update the Confluence page linked above.

Overview:
- Main day: Nov 11 (developer meetup + 3 breakouts)
- Staff arrival: Nov 10 afternoon (onsite prep & tech check)
- Tear-down: Nov 12 morning
- Venue: Umeda Conference Hall - Room A/B/C (contact: Nippon Event Co.)

Key contacts (phone + notes):
- Venue ops: Akiko Tanaka — +81 80-1234-5678 — primary on-site host, speaks English; ask for stage riser kit A
- A/V lead: Daisuke Mori — +81 80-8765-4321 — bring spare XLR -> 3.5mm adapters, HDMI splitter (2x)
- Caterer: Hanami Catering — +81 90-5555-1212 — vegetarian boxes confirmed for 60; confirm final headcount by Nov 8
- Local travel coordinator: Kenta Suzuki — +81 70-4444-3333 — can assist with last-mile taxis for VIPs
- Emergency (Redwood Japan onsite rep): Kenji Watanabe — +81 90-9999-0000

Expense reminders / reimbursement rules (staff notes):
- Use company card where possible for venue and AV deposits. If paying OOO (cash/credit), collect original receipts and a VAT invoice from vendor.
- Per diem: 6,000 JPY/day for domestic staff (overnight days only). Record check-in/check-out times in the expense claim.
- Local vendor VAT: get "領収書 (ryoushuusho)" + VAT invoice if available. Some small vendors don't provide VAT lines; capture bank transfer confirmation.
- Taxi rules: short rides under 1,500 JPY do not need itemized notes if below petty cash threshold. Anything >5,000 JPY must have printed receipt and justification.
- Foreign cards: if using personal cards for emergency expenses, file under "Out-of-pocket - Events" with CC statement snapshot and receipt within 7 days.

Receipts workflow (quick):
1) Scan all paper receipts with Expensify mobile app immediately after purchase.
2) Tag as "OSAKA_NOV25" and put note: purpose + approver (e.g., Ravi).
3) Submit weekly; final reconciliation due Nov 20.

Preflight checklist (staff arrival day — Nov 10):
- [ ] Meet venue ops 3:00pm — load-in route + elevator key
- [ ] Stage mic check with keynote laptop (ensure audio from USB-C macbook)
- [ ] Swap house projector lamp (spare in A/V box)
- [ ] Confirm WiFi SSID/access passes for speakers (ask Akiko for temporary WPA2 pass)
- [ ] Print badge sheet (100) + speaker name tags (laminate if possible)
- [ ] Collect catering delivery window (confirm 1:30pm Nov 11)

Onsite staff quick roles (assignments):
- Floor manager: Ravi — escalation, scheduling, timekeeping for sessions.
- AV backup: Kenji — manage adapters, backups, and fallback laptop.
- Registration desk: Sofia + temp contractors (2) — check-in, badges, swag distribution.
- Finance liaison: Maya (me) — collect receipts, petty cash float (30,000 JPY on Nov 10 morning), expense triage.

Petty cash & float:
- Float amount: 30,000 JPY (withdraw at office beforehand). Keep physical log sheet (template in Confluence).
- Use petty cash for taxis under 3,000 JPY, small incidentals. Any single spend >10,000 JPY needs lead approval.

Vendor handoff notes (write-down items to confirm during load-in):
- AV: confirm mic types (lavalier wired x2, handheld x3), spare batteries (AA x24), DI boxes (2).
- Stage: riser size, backdrop hanging points — we need extra gaffer tape and stage skirt pins.
- Catering: allergen stickers on boxes (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free).
- Signage: 2 A1 wayfinding boards, 6 door decals. Confirm delivery time and contact at vendor.

Unresolved questions / to confirm (TODO):
- Ask legal: is it ok to provide small speaker gifts (tech swag ~JPY 3,000 each) without additional paperwork? (Concur policy check)
- Confirm whether Redwood JP will cover extra A/V staff overtime (beyond 8pm). Who signs off?
- Need VAT invoice template in English for smaller vendors — who owns this artifact? (linked_artifacts may be updated)

Logistics & travel details (staff list snapshot):
- Maya Chen (me) — flight: SFO -> NRT -> KIX (arrive Nov 10 13:40 local) — ARRIVAL: Terminal 1, meet at ground transport desk
- Ravi Patel — flight LHR->KIX (arrive Nov 10 15:10)
- Sofia Martinez — train from Tokyo (Shinkansen, dep 09:00 Nov 10)

Notes for tax/finance filing: 
- Tag all OS cash GL codes as: events.japan.osaka.nov2025 in expense system.
- Expense policy exception for external contractors: need signed SOW + invoice with Japanese corporate hanko or electronic signature.

Useful quick links / refs:
- Confluence event page (master): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/EVENTS/OSAKA+Nov+2025
- Expense policy (Japan): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/FIN/Expense+Policy+Japan
- AV inventory spreadsheet (shared): https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/AV-INVENTORY-2025

Post-event actions (by Nov 20):
- Final expense submission (all staff)
- Reconcile petty cash and return balance to finance (photo of bank deposit slip)
- Upload final attendee list and survey CSV to Confluence
- Postmortem: brief 30-min sync (Nov 25) — notes on what to change for next region run

Quick heuristics I use when triaging receipts on-site: 
- If a receipt is handwritten (local taxi), ask for any digital confirmation (card txn screenshot).
- When in doubt about VAT: capture photo of vendor business card + receipt and flag for finance.
- Keep small change in labeled envelope by day; log amounts as you spend.

End-of-file notes (personal):
- Remember passport photocopy for backup (store encrypted in 1Password vault: Events/Osaka).
- Bring spare USB-C hub + dongles (I always forget the HDMI one).

If anything is missing ping me in DMs (Maya) or drop into #events-japan. This doc is live — update as you confirm.
